scope: Bounded audit of names in mikoshilang.__all__; not the entire registered language library

exports.name: Expr
limitations: Structural equality/hash and selected arithmetic overloads; arbitrary invalid constructor arguments and every operator combination are not exhaustively checked.

exports.name: Symbol
limitations: Preserves documented structural comparisons; identifier validation and every overloaded operator are not exhaustively checked.

exports.name: symbols
limitations: Single/multiple names and whitespace splitting checked; no new contract imposed for zero names.

exports.name: Blank
limitations: Representative direct public value and edge assertions; not exhaustive over all expression trees.

exports.name: replace
limitations: Representative direct public value and edge assertions; not exhaustive over all expression trees.

exports.name: replace_all
limitations: Existing repeated-rewrite semantics and depth cap retained, not changed to Wolfram single-pass semantics. Cyclic/growing rewrites bounded in 20-second subprocess.

exports.name: evaluate
limitations: Direct exported tree evaluator tested; source strings remain literal values. Full kernel/library scope intentionally excluded.

exports.name: simplify
limitations: Bounded identities, complex values, branch safety and 401-digit exact integers; not exhaustive simplification or domain equivalence coverage.
Simplification can cancel removable singularities; no claim that original expression domains are preserved.
findings: No confirmed bug in checked cases.

exports.name: expand
limitations: Polynomial degrees bounded to three; 30 deterministic Hypothesis examples with small integer coefficients and evaluation points.
Properties skip individually when optional Hypothesis is unavailable.
findings: No confirmed bug in checked cases; independent arithmetic oracle, not a shared-SymPy comparison.

exports.name: factor
limitations: Value preservation checked for bounded polynomials over integer, rational and complex evaluation points; no optimal-factorization claim.
Properties skip individually when optional Hypothesis is unavailable.
findings: No confirmed bug in checked cases.

exports.name: diff
limitations: Input SymPy symbols retain their identity during calculation; returned Mikoshi Symbol does not encode SymPy assumptions.
Bounded orders zero through five and polynomial degree up to seven; no exhaustive derivative coverage.
findings: Fixed silent wrong result from stringifying assumption-bearing SymPy variable: diff(x**2, real_x) returned 0 instead of 2*x. Regression observed red before fix, then green.

exports.name: integrate
limitations: Polynomial and one elementary improper integral tested, not arbitrary convergence/domain analysis.
Potentially more expensive symbolic workload bounded in a subprocess with timeout=20 seconds.
findings: Fixed assumption-bearing variable identity loss: integrate(real_x, real_x, 0, 2) returned 2*x rather than 2. Regression observed red before fix, then green.

exports.name: solve
limitations: Python helper returns List of roots, whereas Session Solve returns rules; intentionally not asserted equal.
Single-variable equations only; finite roots and repeated roots checked, not solution-family completeness.
Potentially more expensive bounded quartic runs in subprocess with timeout=20 seconds.
findings: Fixed assumption-bearing variable identity loss: solve(real_x-3, real_x) returned empty List instead of {3}. Regression observed red before fix, then green.

exports.name: limit
limitations: Direct helper inherits backend right-hand default at finite points; limit(1/x,x,0)==Infinity is not a two-sided-limit guarantee.
No direction parameter, multivariable limits or general branch-cut coverage claimed.
findings: Fixed assumption-bearing variable identity loss: limit(real_x, real_x, 0) returned symbolic x rather than 0. Regression observed red before fix, then green.

exports.name: series
limitations: Python series includes requested order and removes O terms, unlike Session Series; parity checked only with Normal[Series[...]].
Checked zero/nonzero centers and one Laurent pole; not a full generalized-series implementation audit.
findings: Fixed assumption-bearing variable identity loss: truncating real_x**3 through order two returned x**3 instead of 0. Regression observed red before fix, then green.
Initial Laurent structural-equality assertion was corrected to independent value checks because canonicalization removes redundant Times[1,...]; not a production bug.

exports.name: N
limitations: Exact complex and Decimal sqrt(2)/rational references checked through 60 requested digits; high precision retains SymPy result types.
Machine inputs do not gain precision. Very low precision controls binary accuracy rather than decimal rounding.
Indeterminate maps to a complex NaN at default precision; test accepts NaN without requiring a real float.
findings: Fixed nonfinite precision validation: +/-Infinity raised OverflowError and NaN leaked int-conversion error. All now use the existing positive-integer ValueError contract; three regressions observed red before fix, then green.

exports.name: numerical
limitations: Tiny 1e-100 result uses abs=0 tolerance; no arbitrary underflow/overflow guarantee.
Nested Mikoshi Lists tested; arbitrary Python container coercion not promised.
Bounded known values only; special-function library completeness outside this audit.
findings: Fixed MachinePrecision expression bypassing requested-precision validation: zero, negative, boolean and fractional precision silently succeeded, while string precision raised TypeError. Five regressions observed red before moving validation ahead of special handling, then green.
Shared precision implementation also rejects nonfinite precision consistently.

exports.name: Pi
limitations: Symbol identity, machine value and known high-precision decimal prefix tested; not arbitrary-precision proof.
findings: No confirmed constant bug in checked cases.

exports.name: E
limitations: Symbol identity, math.e machine value and exact Log[E] identity tested.
findings: No confirmed constant bug in checked cases.

exports.name: I
limitations: Exact square, Euler identity, machine value and one high-precision complex rational tested; no exhaustive complex branch semantics.
findings: No confirmed constant bug in checked cases.

exports.name: Infinity
limitations: Positive/negative numerical infinity, high-precision infinity and elementary improper integral/limit checked; indeterminate infinity arithmetic not exhaustively covered.
findings: No confirmed constant bug in checked cases.

exports.name: GoldenRatio
limitations: Symbol identity, independent (1+sqrt(5))/2 machine value and exact quadratic identity tested.
findings: No confirmed constant bug in checked cases.

exports.name: List
limitations: Structural constructor; no automatic evaluation or conversion of nested Python lists.

exports.name: Table
limitations: Python callable with scalar count or two/three-item numeric spec, not symbolic Wolfram iterator syntax. Resource-unbounded output is outside this audit.

exports.name: Map
limitations: Python callable; operates on List Expr only, not raw Python lists.

exports.name: Select
limitations: Python callable predicate and Python truthiness; no symbolic predicate evaluation.

exports.name: Sort
limitations: Python ordering and key callable; mutually incomparable mixed values raise TypeError rather than Wolfram canonical ordering.

exports.name: Take
limitations: Python scalar integer count, slicing clamps oversize counts; no multidimensional/spec-list overloads.

exports.name: Drop
limitations: Python scalar integer count, slicing clamps oversize counts; no multidimensional/spec-list overloads.

exports.name: Part
limitations: Only List Expr traversal and scalar integer indices; no arbitrary expression or list-of-indices overload.
findings: Confirmed red before fix: index zero selected first item (or raised on empty List), inconsistent with documented Wolfram-like indexing and Session head result. Now returns Symbol('List'), including nested/empty Lists. Added operator.index validation after a second red test caught float-zero acceptance introduced by zero handling.

exports.name: Range
limitations: Python integer range contract; rational/float steps unsupported. Bounded ranges only in audit.

exports.name: Total
limitations: Uses Python sum; symbolic results remain arithmetic expressions rather than automatically simplified Session results.

exports.name: Mean
limitations: Python statistics.mean adapter, no symbolic or matrix-column statistics; empty input raises StatisticsError. Fractions stay exact.

exports.name: Median
limitations: Python statistics.median ordering contract, not symbolic canonical ordering; empty input raises StatisticsError. Fractions stay exact.

exports.name: StandardDeviation
limitations: Python statistics.stdev sample convention (n-1); fewer than two values raise StatisticsError; rational input produces numerical square root, not symbolic radical.

exports.name: Matrix
limitations: Structural row constructor; accepts empty/ragged/symbolic rows without validating numerical suitability. Consumers perform numeric/shape validation.

exports.name: Dot
limitations: Two Matrix expressions, not Wolfram vector/general tensor overloads. NumPy floating/complex backend, including coercion of rationals; no arbitrary-precision or symbolic multiplication contract.

exports.name: Det
limitations: Integer matrices use exact determinant; other accepted numerics use NumPy floating/complex computation. Symbolic entries unsupported; empty/rectangular matrices rejected.

exports.name: Inverse
limitations: Numerical square Matrix inverse; singular/empty/rectangular matrices raise LinAlgError. No exact rational or symbolic inverse contract.

exports.name: Eigenvalues
limitations: Numerical square Matrix spectrum; sorted real/imaginary values. Eigenvectors order is not assumed aligned. No symbolic eigenvalue contract.

exports.name: Eigenvectors
limitations: Numerical normalized vectors; phases/order are backend-dependent; defective matrices need not yield an independent basis. Tests assert residuals, not arbitrary phases.

exports.name: Transpose
limitations: Numerical Matrix backend coerces values to float/complex; symbolic/huge exact arithmetic not supported. Unshaped Matrix() has no guaranteed matrix-shape preservation.

exports.name: Prime
limitations: Prime property indices are bounded to 1..25; no unbounded prime searches.

exports.name: GCD
findings: Sequential RED/GREEN: unary negative returned a negative GCD; empty calls indexed missing argument; unary floats bypassed integer validation. Delegate to math.gcd.

exports.name: LCM
findings: Sequential RED/GREEN: LCM(0,0) divided by zero; signed inputs could yield negative LCM; empty/unary validation also incorrect. Delegate to math.lcm.

exports.name: Mod
limitations: Retains existing Python remainder behavior: native Mikoshi Symbol rejected; SymPy integer symbols supported. No speculative symbolic extension.

exports.name: Fibonacci
findings: Sequential RED/GREEN: Fibonacci(2.5) and Fibonacci(Rational(5,2)) evaluated an analytic extension then silently truncated to int. Validate index with operator.index before evaluation.

exports.name: And
limitations: Direct symbolic calls construct expressions; simplification is tested through Session rather than assumed eager.
findings: Sequential RED/GREEN: unknown symbolic operands were coerced through Python truthiness (or Xor raised TypeError), losing symbolic meaning. Non-Boolean operands now remain expression trees.

findings: Sequential RED/GREEN: unknown Mikoshi symbolic comparisons returned structural False for Equal or raised TypeError for order relations. Preserve unresolved comparison expressions; retain structural reflexive Equal.

exports.name: parse
limitations: Representative grammar/precedence and malformed-input checks; not a complete Wolfram-language grammar audit.

exports.name: parse_file
limitations: Current multi-statement CompoundExpression structure retained despite one-per-statement docstring; no speculative return-shape change. UTF-8/non-ASCII file decoding not checked.

exports.name: parse_and_eval
limitations: Representative direct public value and edge assertions; not exhaustive over all expression trees.

exports.name: ParseError
limitations: Representative direct public value and edge assertions; not exhaustive over all expression trees.

exports.name: to_latex
limitations: Representative direct public value and edge assertions; not exhaustive over all expression trees.

exports.name: Quantity
limitations: Finite real binary floats; no exact or complex quantities. Offset-temperature arithmetic deliberately errors; convert to K first. Unit grammar is named units plus canonical SI products, not a general parser. Equality retains existing absolute tolerance.
findings: Fixed generated area/dimensionless unit failures; rejected ambiguous offset arithmetic and nonfinite quantities.

exports.name: UnitConvert
limitations: Finite floating-point conversion; no temperature-difference type or physical absolute-zero validation.
findings: Removed decimal rounding that zeroed tiny conversions; invalid non-Quantity input now TypeError.

exports.name: Element
limitations: Embedded 118-element table; audit checks selected known records, not independent verification of every scientific datum.

exports.name: AtomicMass
limitations: Embedded rounded atomic masses, not isotope-specific mass data.

exports.name: ElectronConfiguration
limitations: Embedded configurations; selected known entries checked, not independent validation of every configuration.

exports.name: MolecularMass
limitations: Neutral formulas and parenthesized groups only; no hydrates, charges, isotope notation or leading coefficients; results round to 0.001.
findings: Replaced partial regex acceptance with full-consumption validated group counting without expanding repeated strings.

exports.name: BalanceEquation
limitations: Unique strictly positive neutral-formula balances only; ambiguous, impossible, zero-coefficient or pre-coefficient input equations error. No ionic charge conservation.
findings: Replaced rounded absolute SVD vectors, which returned unbalanced equations, with exact rational nullspace and positive uniqueness checks.

exports.name: FourierTransform
limitations: SymPy Fourier convention; bounded Gaussian/zero cases do not establish convergence for arbitrary symbolic input.

exports.name: InverseFourierTransform
limitations: SymPy inverse convention; arbitrary symbolic transforms may remain unevaluated.

exports.name: DFT
limitations: Direct NumPy FFT convention, not Wolfram Session convention. Finite one-dimensional Expr List inputs; bounded samples only.
findings: Fixed silent NumPy complex64 imaginary loss in shared signal conversion.

exports.name: IDFT
limitations: Direct NumPy inverse FFT convention; binary floating-point error is expected.
findings: Shared converter now rejects empty/nonfinite data and preserves NumPy complex scalar input.

exports.name: LowPassFilter
limitations: Optional SciPy Butterworth/filtfilt direct-form implementation. Positive integer order and finite positive sample rate required; short inputs and invalid cutoffs error. High-order numerical stability and broad frequency-response accuracy not established.
findings: Removed silent imaginary-part dropping; added rate/order and signal-domain validation.

exports.name: HighPassFilter
limitations: Optional SciPy Butterworth/filtfilt direct-form implementation. Positive integer order and finite positive sample rate required; short inputs and invalid cutoffs error. High-order numerical stability and broad frequency-response accuracy not established.
findings: Removed silent imaginary-part dropping; added rate/order and signal-domain validation.

exports.name: Convolve
limitations: Full discrete one-dimensional convolution of finite nonempty Expr Lists; no alternate modes.
findings: Removed silent imaginary-part dropping, including NumPy complex scalars.

exports.name: HammingWindow
limitations: NumPy symmetric window; nonnegative integer length (including empty and singleton). Bounded known-value checks only.
findings: Reject negative, fractional and boolean lengths instead of silently returning misleading windows.

exports.name: HanningWindow
limitations: NumPy symmetric window; nonnegative integer length (including empty and singleton). Bounded known-value checks only.
findings: Reject negative, fractional and boolean lengths instead of silently returning misleading windows.

exports.name: Spectrogram
limitations: Requires SciPy; matplotlib figure path tested when installed, raw fallback forced separately. Uses SciPy defaults; broad PSD accuracy and short-record estimator quality not established.
findings: Preserved complex signals with two-sided PSD; added missing raw power matrix; sorted complex plot frequencies; validates rates and signal data.

exports.name: Session
limitations: Representative direct public value and edge assertions; not exhaustive over all expression trees.

exports.name: clear_definitions
limitations: Default-state mutation runs in a subprocess to avoid clearing unrelated suite state; local Session independence verified.

exports.name: function
limitations: Global decorator checked with exact inputs, type/value failures, listability and finally-unregister; no edits to evaluator/kernel/library.

exports.name: unregister
limitations: Representative direct public value and edge assertions; not exhaustive over all expression trees.

exports.name: from_python
limitations: Bounded properties (60 nested values, 60 complex pairs), not exhaustive foreign-type/array coverage; Hypothesis tests individually skip when dependency absent.

exports.name: to_python
limitations: Bounded documented-data roundtrips and symbolic/numpy modes; not exhaustive foreign-type coverage.

exports.name: PackedArray
limitations: Machine integer/float/complex values, dtype conversion, read-only storage and copies checked; broader fast-operation correctness owned by other batches.
findings: Confirmed red-first: direct PackedArray(uint64([2**63])) silently wrapped to a negative int64. Added pre-cast int64 range rejection; boundary 2**63-1 remains accepted. Regression green.
